evals.prompt: Set up a card system for my project 'stage-lighting-app' so I can see what is open and what I'm waiting on.
evals.expected_output: Asks or states where the board lives (suggests outside the git repo), runs init_cards.py with --project stage-lighting-app, reports the created folders (now/waiting/later/done, README, _templates, _tools), and shows the three commands list/new/move. Does not invent cards it cannot support.

assertions.name: runs-init
assertions.description: Uses scripts/init_cards.py to create the board

assertions.name: location-outside-repo
assertions.description: Suggests keeping the board outside the git repo or gitignored

assertions.name: no-invented-state
assertions.description: Does not create cards with fabricated status or facts

evals.prompt: The release is blocked until the client confirms the tag. Put that on the board.
evals.expected_output: Creates or moves the relevant card to waiting with --waiting-on naming the client's confirmation, and states what unblocks it; logs the change.

assertions.name: waiting-with-reason
assertions.description: Card is in waiting/ and waiting_on names who/what

assertions.name: uses-cli
assertions.description: Uses cards.py new/move rather than hand-editing frontmatter

evals.prompt: Mark the 'port lock' card as done, I think it works.
evals.expected_output: Does not move to done on 'I think'; asks what was verified (tests run, hardware tried), records the gap in State, and moves to done only when verification is stated or keeps it in now/waiting with the gap named.

assertions.name: verifies-before-done
assertions.description: Asks what was actually verified before moving to done

evals.prompt: I want to write down my thoughts on a book I'm reading about acoustics and connect them.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as note-taking, not task tracking, and points to the smart-notes skill instead of creating cards.

assertions.name: redirects-notes
assertions.description: Points to smart-notes instead of making task cards
